Info

Who we are
We are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!


Aufgaben


Your tasks - this is what awaits you in detail

  • You plan and run research across the full spectrum, from foundational studies that shape immediate product decisions to strategic work that influences our long-term user experience vision and goals
  • You work closely with product managers, product designers and engineers across several product areas and get involved early, while problems are still being defined

  • You use AI in your daily research work and help shape how our team applies it
  • You contribute to our research repository and make insights reusable, so teams can build on what we already know

Profil

title: Forward Deployed Product Strategist (m/w/d)
description:
🚀 Werde unser neue Forward Deployed Product Strategist (m/w/d)

Du willst KI nicht nur strategisch denken, sondern messbaren Business Impact schaffen? Du denkst 0-to-1, hast eine Builder-Mentalität und bewegst dich sicher zwischen Vorstand, Product und Engineering.

Unser Ansatz: AI-Native Execution – relevante Opportunities identifizieren, schnell umsetzen und Data & AI dort produktiv machen, wo echter Mehrwert entsteht.

Deine Rolle als Forward Deployed Product Strategist

Du verbindest Strategie, Product Thinking, Hands-on Execution und Account Ownership.

Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden identifizierst du die relevantesten Data-&-AI-Opportunities und treibst sie mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers von Discovery und Validierung bis in die produktive Nutzung und Skalierung.

Dein Erfolg misst sich nicht an Slides, Features oder Backlogs, sondern daran, was tatsächlich genutzt wird, messbaren Business Impact erzielt und beim Kunden weiter skaliert werden kann.

Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

Du verantwortest Data-&-AI-Opportunities end-to-end – von Discovery bis Production – und übernimmst dabei strategische, kommerzielle, fachliche und technische Verantwortung:

  • Opportunity Discovery: Du arbeitest direkt mit Business-Verantwortlichen, Führungskräften und Nutzer zusammen, verstehst ihre Prozesse und Herausforderungen und identifizierst die Data-&-AI-Opportunities mit dem größten potenziellen Business Impact.

  • Account Ownership & Growth: Du bist eine zentrale Bezugsperson für den Kunden, entwickelst ein kohärentes Zielbild für den Einsatz von Data & AI und baust bestehende Engagements durch neue, wertstiftende Opportunities strategisch weiter aus.

  • Product Discovery & Priorisierung: Du übersetzt komplexe Business-Probleme in konkrete Produkt- und Lösungshypothesen, priorisierst nach Business Value, Machbarkeit und Nutzerbedarf und entscheidest, was zuerst validiert werden muss.

  • Rapid Prototyping (0-to-1): Du baust selbst erste funktionierende Prototypen, testest sie mit echten Nutzer und nutzt die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse, um schnell über Weiterentwicklung, Anpassung oder Stopp zu entscheiden.

  • Production & Scale: Gemeinsam mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers entwickelst du validierte Prototypen zu robusten, produktionsreifen Lösungen weiter. Als Owner der Opportunity bleibst du vom ersten Konzept bis zur produktiven Nutzung und Skalierung verantwortlich.

  • Partnerschaft mit Forward Deployed Engineers: Du arbeitest eng im Tandem mit unseren Engineers. Du bringst Business-Kontext, Product Thinking und Rapid Prototyping ein; gemeinsam verbindet ihr diese mit Engineering Excellence und integriert Lösungen in bestehende Architekturen, Datenlandschaften und Prozesse.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Du agierst als Trusted Advisor für Senior- und Executive-Stakeholder und berätst sie zu KI-Potenzialen, Investitionsentscheidungen, Prioritäten sowie technologischen und geschäftlichen Trade-offs.

  • Outcome Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Ergebnis – nicht nur für Deliverables. Entscheidend sind produktive Nutzung, Adoption, Business Impact und die nachhaltige Skalierung erfolgreicher Lösungen.



Das bringst du mit – deine Skills & Erfahrung

  • Business-Value-Orientierung: Du kannst komplexe und zunächst unscharfe Business-Probleme strukturieren, die entscheidenden Hebel identifizieren und daraus priorisierte, umsetzbare Data-&-AI-Initiativen ableiten.

  • Product Thinking: Du denkst vom Problem und Nutzerbedarf aus, formulierst Hypothesen, validierst früh und priorisierst konsequent nach Wirkung statt nach Feature-Menge.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Senior- und Executive-Stakeholder zu technologischen Möglichkeiten, Business Value und Trade-offs zu beraten – von Pre-Sales und Discovery bis zur Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Engagements.

  • 0-to-1 Delivery: Du hast einen nachweisbaren Track Record darin, aus einer Idee schnell etwas Testbares zu bauen, mit echten Nutzer zu validieren und anhand von Feedback, Daten und operativen Ergebnissen zu iterieren. Builder-Mentalität statt reiner Slide-Produktion.

  • High Agency: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, schaffst Klarheit in unstrukturierten Situationen und kommst auch dann voran, wenn Problem, Scope oder Lösungsweg zu Beginn noch nicht vollständig definiert sind.

  • Umgang mit Komplexität: Du kannst mit komplexen Prozessen, gewachsenen Systemlandschaften und großen, unstrukturierten oder qualitativ heterogenen Datenbeständen umgehen, ohne den Fokus auf schnelle Ergebnisse zu verlieren.

  • Hands-on AI & Technology: Du verfügst über ein solides technisches Verständnis und praktische Erfahrung beim Entwickeln von Data-&-AI-Anwendungen – beispielsweise mit Python, APIs, LLMs und modernen AI-Toolchains. Du kannst selbst einen funktionierenden Prototyp bauen und technischen Teams auf Augenhöhe begegnen.

  • Commercial Mindset: Du erkennst, wo aus einem erfolgreichen Use Case weiteres Potenzial entsteht, und kannst daraus gemeinsam mit dem Kunden neue Initiativen und langfristige Engagements entwickeln.

Ausbildung

Du hast einen Studienabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft mit technischem Schwerpunkt oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet. Noch wichtiger ist uns jedoch, dass du relevante praktische Erfahrung und einen nachweisbaren Track Record mitbringst.

Sprachkenntnisse – Deutsch ist für diese Rolle unverzichtbar

Du verfügst über fließende, verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, da du eigenständig mit deutschsprachigen Stakeholdern bis auf Executive-Level arbeitest. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch setzen wir ebenfalls voraus.

Warum du bei uns genau richtig bist

  • AI-Native Execution: Wir verbinden strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzung – schnell vom Problem zur validierten Lösung und von dort in die produktive Nutzung.

  • Data & AI mit echtem Impact: Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen Data-&-AI-Challenges – von der ersten Opportunity bis zur produktiven und skalierbaren Lösung.

  • Ownership statt Zuarbeit: Du bekommst Verantwortung für Kunden, Opportunities und Outcomes. Wir suchen Menschen, die Entscheidungen treffen, Dinge bauen und Ergebnisse verantworten – nicht nur Empfehlungen formulieren.

  • Strategie trifft Engineering: Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Product und Technologie und eng mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers zusammen.

  • Steile Lernkurve & Entwicklung: Du arbeitest mit einem starken Team aus Data-, AI-, Product- und Engineering-Expert und entwickelst dich durch anspruchsvolle Projekte, regelmäßige Trainings und Zertifizierungen kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Hands-on Unternehmenskultur: Kurze Wege, hohe Eigenverantwortung, Teamspirit und der Anspruch, aus neuen Technologien messbaren Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Über KI performance

Wir transformieren die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen mit Daten arbeiten, und machen sie bereit für die Zukunft der Künstlichen Intelligenz. Mit unserer Expertise in der Entwicklung von Datenplattformen und KI-gestützten Lösungen schaffen wir messbaren Mehrwert – stets mit einem klaren Fokus auf Business und Strategie. Unsere Projekte reichen von globalen Datenplattformen bis hin zu innovativen Gen AI-Anwendungen und leisten einen direkten Beitrag zum Erfolg führender DAX-Unternehmen. Durch den Einsatz modernster Technologien setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in der digitalen Transformation und arbeiten eng mit Microsoft, Databricks und unserem KI group-Ecosystem zusammen, um nachhaltige und zukunftsweisende Lösungen zu realisieren.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von zukunftsorientierten, neugierigen und aufgeschlossenen Menschen, die die digitale Welt aktiv gestalten. Um dieses dynamische Umfeld zu erhalten, legen wir großen Wert auf Vielfalt, Innovation und eine enge Zusammenarbeit in Teams. Wenn du mehr über unsere Kultur und Benefits erfahren möchtest, schaue gerne auf unserer Karriereseite vorbei.

Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft datengetriebener Geschäftsmodelle zu gestalten?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt – Wir freuen uns auf dich! 🚀

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d) German speaking
description:
Why we are looking for support

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team in Germany. 

You’ll be part of a delivery team working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, B2B Commerce, and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud. While you don’t need prior experience with Consumer Goods Cloud, you’ll be expected to learn and work with it as part of our core solution landscape.

This is a German-speaking position. Professional fluency in German and English is required, as you will work directly with German-speaking clients and international project teams.

To give you more insights of your working environment, on the organization level you will work on a regular basis in a team of 5-10 developers to gather ideas & improve already existing processes. On a project level you will work in an agile project team of 4-7 people, depending on the project size, to deliver projects to our clients.
What you will find with us: 

  • Real-world Salesforce projects that go beyond textbook use cases
  • A team that values thoughtful engineering, scalable delivery, and ownership
  • Opportunities to learn Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud in live client environments
  • Clear growth paths toward technical lead, solution architect, or industry specialist roles


Your tasks

  • Lead the development, and deployment of Salesforce solutions using different Cloud solutions.
  • Develop end-to-end Salesforce solutions using both configuration and customization
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and deliver scalable solutions
  • Develop Salesforce components using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flows
  • Work closely with solution architects and functional consultants to build scalable solutions across Sales, Service, Commerce, and Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using APIs and middleware tools (e.g. MuleSoft, SAP CPI)
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and quality assurance
  • Contribute to DevOps automation using Git, Gearset, or DevOps Center
  • Suggest improvements to performance, reusability, or developer experience
  • Support defect resolution, enhancements, and roll-out activities
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest Salesforce innovations and contribute to internal initiatives and team growth.


Requirements

  • 3–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Strong skills in Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, and Flow
  • Experience working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Commerce implementations
  • Understanding of integration design, platform limits, and test automation
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control and CI/CD tooling
  • Experience working in structured project teams or consulting environments
  • Interest in learning Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and applying it in real-world programs
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex technical issues.
  • Fluent in English and German - other languages are a plus.
  • Demonstrated drive to improve how things are done—whether in performance, automation, or usability
  • The ability to collaborate across technical and functional teams
  • A mindset geared toward learning and adapting in enterprise-scale environments


Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Integration Architecture Designer)
  • Experience with Experience Cloud, CPQ, or Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Background working with or delivering for consumer goods or retail clients
  • Familiarity with agile delivery tools like JIRA, Confluence, and TestRail
  • Experience working with XML based design contracts and Cordova mobile framework

title: Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung (all Genders)
description:
DEINE KÜNFTIGE ROLLE.

Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung: Führen und selbst entwickeln.

Als Tech Lead übernimmst Du die technische Führung der Entwicklungsteams und stellst sicher, dass Softwarelösungen nachhaltig, skalierbar und wartbar umgesetzt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern und Entwicklern zusammen, übersetzt Architekturvorgaben in konkrete Lösungen und unterstützt die Teams bei technischen Entscheidungen. Dein Fokus liegt auf der erfolgreichen Umsetzung moderner Softwarearchitekturen, der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Entwicklungsprozesse sowie der Förderung technischer Exzellenz innerhalb der Teams. Dabei bleibst Du hands-on und entwickelst aktiv mit.

Wie die Rolle heißt, ist uns dabei weniger wichtig als das, was Du darin tust – bei anderen Arbeitgebern findest Du sie als Teamleitung Softwareentwicklung oder als Engineering Lead.

Klingt gut für Dich? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns!

Welche Aufgaben erwarten mich in meiner Rolle?
  • Technische Führung, Coaching und Coding-Unterstützung von Entwicklerteams.
  • Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Architekturvorgaben.
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Einführung neuer Produkte und Funktionen.
  • Verantwortung für die technische Qualität der entwickelten Software.
  • Definition und Durchsetzung von Entwicklungsstandards und Best Practices.
  • Mitarbeit bei Architekturentscheidungen sowie Erstellung technischer Konzepte.
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbau und Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mitarbeit bei Deployments.
  • Entwicklung und Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines.
  • Sicherstellung von Security-Anforderungen und Secure-Coding-Praktiken.
  • Unterstützung bei Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Konzepten.
  • Analyse und Lösung technischer Herausforderungen und Performance-Probleme.
  • Koordination technischer Aktivitäten innerhalb agiler Entwicklungsteams.
  • Durchführung von Code Reviews und Förderung hoher Softwarequalität.
  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne Stakeholder und Kunden.

title: Senior Product Designer (B2B SaaS Startup)
description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!
We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right. 
Trusted by leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka, we've achieved 3x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

  • Own the full loop. Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.
  • Solve from first principles. Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.
  • Sweat the final 10%. Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.
  • Work in small, focused pods. No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.
  • Be accountable to outcomes. Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.
  • Stretch beyond design. Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.


Who we’re looking for

Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.

  • Fluency in English (C1+) is required. German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.
  • Genuine design craft with a track record: you've shipped interfaces real users navigated without explanation, and you can point to the metric that moved.
  • Strong visual sensibility, high standards, and an eye for detail.
  • Range across Design, Product, and Engineering: you've gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief, and used AI coding tools to build something real. You're not dependent on an engineer to realize your vision.
  • You've built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster, and you know when to trust, edit, or reject AI output.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity: you ship, collect signal, and iterate rather than waiting for full clarity.
  • You are excited to show your work (portfolio or examples).
  • Ideally you've worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences (fintech, healthtech, logistics, compliance), but that's not a must-have.
  • Berlin-based or willing to relocate.
This role is not for you if…
  • You want a PM to define the problem and an engineer to implement the solution.
  • You resist working in code or with AI.
  • You hand off polished Figma files and believe your job is done.
  • You judge yourself on taste alone, not outcomes.

Interview process:

  1. First Call — Intro on what we do with Max (Hiring manager) 
  2. Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Sebastian (Designer) 
  3. Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Product team (group call)
  4. On-site Day — Meet our team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.
  5. (Potentially) quick ,,vibe check'' call- with founder (Leonie or Hendrik)


Why us?

What you can expect

Why revel8?

title: System Administrator (w/m/d) Defense Products
description:
Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen.

Join our highly motivated team of experts dedicated to combating cybersecurity threats. As a System Administrator, you will plan and operate our cutting-edge defense platforms alongside site reliability engineers and network engineers. These platforms are crucial for protecting our hosting products and infrastructure, encompassing classic DDoS mitigation, modern Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Zero Trust strategies, and our Content Delivery Network (CDN). We foster a culture that highly values creative ideas, agile working methods, initiative, and participation.

As an Specialist in our Defense squad, you act as a vital shield against daily DDoS and sophisticated cyber attacks. You are the first line of defense, dedicated to neutralizing threats through technical mastery and proactive mitigation.

We are hiring for this role in Karlsruhe and/or Berlin. You will join a distributed, international Defense Platform Services team of approximately 8–9 experts. You will work within specialized squads for Operations, SRE, and NRE to provide comprehensive protection for the group’s infrastructure across Germany and beyond.

Tasks

The day-to-day operations of the Defense Platform Services team directly correlate to the financial stability of the United Internet Group. When our defenders succeed, the group’s digital economy remains fluid; your success is measured by the silence of a neutralized threat.

  • Active Defense & DDoS Mitigation: Administer and troubleshoot scrubbing platforms and a complex, large-scale proxy infrastructure. You will engage in the "cat and mouse game" of fighting attacks in real-time—identifying, washing, and neutralizing malicious traffic to protect core cloud and fiber services.
  • Architectural Density & Operational Excellence: You will manage the lifecycle of 800+ Linux-based components within a highly available infrastructure. To maintain 24/7 group-wide protection, this role requires a mandatory on-call service rotation of one week per month, ensuring immediate response to high-priority network threats.
  • Innovation & Data-Driven Defense: We leverage modern AI tools for log analysis and pattern detection. You will bring creative ideas to the table, utilizing the ELK Stack and ClickHouse to manage high-volume telemetry, identify attack signatures, and devise advanced mitigation strategies.
  • Lifecycle & Pipeline Management: Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines in an agile DevOps environment. You will evaluate and integrate new technologies—including Docker and Kubernetes—to ensure our defense architecture remains lean, efficient, and ahead of evolving industry threats.

Qualifications

Because this role manages critical national and corporate infrastructure, the barrier to entry involves both technical mastery and a high degree of professional trust.Therefore, we require 3 to 5 years of platform operating experience at scale. We are looking for an administrator with a "security gene"—a specialized, proactive interest in DDoS mitigation and cyber defense that goes beyond standard system maintenance.

  • Expert-level proficiency in managing complex, distributed Linux environments.
  • Proven experience configuring Nginx as a reverse proxy or Web Application Firewall (WAF).
  • Practical knowledge of BGP, Flowspec, and Anycast routing.
  • A passion for eliminating repetitive tasks through Ansible, Puppet, and Python.
  • Several years of experience in the administration of complex, distributed Linux systems.
  • Proven experience in configuring and operating Nginx as a reverse proxy or web application firewall.
  • Hands-on experience with the deployment of BGP, Flowspec, and Anycast routing on Linux systems and network routers.
  • Strong passion for automation using tools like Ansible, Puppet, and Python to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate DDoS attacks, implement effective countermeasures, and continuously develop our defense platforms.
  • Initial experience with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, or the ELK Stack is beneficial.
  • Like us, you are a strong advocate for Open Source, especially Linux.

Benefits

  • Hybrid working model.
  • Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
  • Subsidized canteen and various free drinks at select locations.
  • Modern office space with excellent public transport connections.
  • Various employee discounts for activities and products.
  • Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
  • Numerous training and development opportunities.
  • Various health offerings, such as sports and wellness courses.

Über IONOS

IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Interim/Freelance Director of IT, Security & Infrastructure (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

Taxfix is building something most companies only talk about: a fully agentic infrastructure layer that every team in the company will depend on. And right now, IT is either the foundation that makes that possible — or the bottleneck that slows it down.

As our Director of Security & IT, you are the difference between those two outcomes. This is not a traditional IT Director role. You won't be managing tickets or keeping the lights on. You'll be building a platform function from the ground up — one that gives every hybrid human-agent team at Taxfix the speed, security, and confidence to move without friction. Reporting to our Chief People Officer and working closely with our Systems Engineer and cross-functional partners across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and People Ops, you'll define the infrastructure and security foundation that turns our agentic ambitions into reality.

The best outcome in this role isn't that IT stays out of the way — it's that IT raises the bar for how the whole organization operates. You'll set standards that others build to, make calls that shape Taxfix's security posture for years, and build the infrastructure layer that our agentic ambitions depend on. This role comes with real authority and real accountability. If you want to be the person who defines what modern IT looks like at a company that's genuinely building the future of work — this is that job.

This is an interim position on a freelance basis.


Your responsibilities:

  • Own the vision and roadmap for Taxfix's internal infrastructure and tooling layer, driving the transition from IT as a ticket-resolving function to an internal platform product that enables every hybrid human-agent team to move faster and more securely.

  • Lead and develop the IT team — including helpdesk, systems engineering, and the incoming Security & Platform Engineer — ensuring clear ownership, structured growth paths, and a high-performing team culture through a period of significant structural change.

  • Own all core IT operations: device management (MDM), identity and access management, workplace technology, SaaS tooling, third-party network provider relationship, and hardware provisioning — maintaining reliability, cost controlling and service quality while progressively raising the bar on what "good" looks like.

  • Set the security strategy and posture for Taxfix's systems and agent ecosystem, embedding security continuously into platform infrastructure rather than applying it as a gate at the end.

  • Work closely with our Systems Engineers and the agentic framework team to build and document the agentic platform layer — including secure sandboxes, credential vaults, and CI/CD pipelines — ensuring infrastructure decisions support the organisation's agentic ambitions.

  • Own IT-specific risk management, compliance controls, and audit readiness across internal systems and infrastructure, partnering with Legal, Compliance, and enterprise risk owners on GDPR/DSGVO, SOC 2, and applicable financial regulatory requirements.

  • Manage supplier relationships and lead the build and lead the build/buy/partner evaluation, making a long-term recommendation grounded in both technical and business considerations.

  • Be the business-facing voice for IT in leadership conversations — translating infrastructure and security decisions into clear business terms and building trusted relationships with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and People Ops.

  • Define and track platform health metrics, service quality, and internal adoption — including establishing internal NPS for IT services as a baseline, driving measurable reductions in ticket volume and mean time to resolution, and reporting transparently on the agentic infrastructure layer.


Your profile:

  • You have proven experience leading an IT or infrastructure function at a scale-up or regulated tech company — including ownership of core IT operations such as helpdesk, MDM, identity management, and workplace technology. You know what it takes to run these reliably while simultaneously raising the ambition of what the function can be.

  • You have built or are capable of building a platform mindset in a team that has historically operated as a support function — you understand what that shift requires culturally, structurally, and in terms of how success gets measured.

  • You bring strong enough technical depth to have credible, substantive conversations with engineers — you can interrogate technical decisions, ask the right questions, and know when to push back.

  • You are security-literate and have hands-on experience setting security strategy: you understand the threat landscape, have navigated compliance and audit obligations in a regulated environment, and know what good security posture looks like at both the infrastructure and application layer.

  • You have experience with agentic or AI infrastructure, or you bring genuine curiosity and a track record of fast learning in emerging technical domains — this space is moving quickly, and so are we.

  • You have managed vendors and external partners, including evaluating and making build/buy/outsource decisions, and you're comfortable owning those relationships end to end.

  • You are familiar with the compliance and data obligations that come with operating in a regulated environment — financial services, tax, or similar — and you've translated those obligations into practical infrastructure and process decisions.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and energised by the opportunity to help shape a function that is being designed in real time — you don't wait for a playbook; you help write it.

  • You grow the people around you: you see early-career team members and ambitious engineers as people to invest in, and you create the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • You are ego-light: you are comfortable with invisible success — the best outcome is that teams don't notice IT because everything works — and you are willing to tell leadership when a request isn't feasible and explain why in terms that land.


Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: AI Engineer, Quality & Evals (m/f/x)
description:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m EUR funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

Your Role

We are looking for an engineer with strong backend, data, and AI systems experience to build the evaluation and observability foundation for production-grade LLM agents used in complex audit workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, data infrastructure, and AI quality. You will build the evaluation systems that power our multimodal retrieval agents and continuously improve critical quality metrics across current and future pipelines.

You’ll work at the edge of applied AI and information retrieval, building multimodal agentic pipelines and solving hard context and agent-harness engineering problems.

This is not a traditional analytics, BI, or dashboarding role. You should expect to write production code, design data architecture, work inside backend systems, and directly improve the quality, cost, reliability, and performance of LLM-based agents.

What you’ll do

You will help build and operate the technical systems around our AI agents, with a focus on data infrastructure, evaluation, observability, and optimization. You will:

  • Build online and offline evaluation systems for LLM agents, including pipelines that use golden datasets, ground-truth data, human review workflows, and experiment results.

  • Create automated quality gates so changes to prompts, context, models, or agent logic can be tested before reaching production.

  • Analyze large volumes of agent traces and executions in columnar and analytical databases such as BigQuery or ClickHouse to identify failure modes, quality regressions, latency issues, reliability gaps, and cost optimization opportunities.

  • Build reliable data retention and replay mechanisms for long-term analysis of production agent behavior.

  • Manage observability tools for tracing, monitoring, debugging, and experiment management of our audit agents.

  • Team up with backend engineers to improve the speed and reliability of our retrieval and reasoning agents.

You will fit into the role if you...

  • Have strong Python and/or backend engineering experience.

  • Have a solid understanding of how LLM and agent systems are evaluated—including deterministic checks, ground truth, LLM-as-judge, human review, and quality metrics—and can reason about when each approach is appropriate.

  • Have deployed and operated systems in the cloud, ideally on GCP.

  • Have hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval or ML pipeline evaluation systems and using LLM observability or experimentation tools such as Braintrust, MLflow, Langfuse, or Weights & Biases.

  • Are comfortable working with analytical databases, data warehouses, columnar stores, and high-volume event or trace data.

  • Understand system design, reliability, observability, monitoring, logging, debugging, and operational trade-offs.

  • Bring senior-level engineering judgment: you can make architectural decisions, communicate trade-offs, and build systems that other engineers can extend.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity, able to reason from first principles, and excited to build infrastructure for AI systems that are actively used in production.

Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Designing data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, event-processing systems, or feedback loops for production data.

  • Building infrastructure around LLM-based products or agentic systems, including optimizing LLM usage, context windows, reasoning tokens, or model selection.

  • Working with production traces from complex distributed systems.

  • Building internal platforms for engineers, domain experts, or operations teams.

  • Using workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal or similar.

  • Familiarity with audit, finance, compliance, or other high-accuracy domains.

  • Experience in an early-stage startup or fast-moving engineering environment.

No-one checks every box. If you’ve shipped retrieval systems and like owning evaluations and pipelines, let’s talk.

What we offer

  • High impact & growth: Shape strategy at a scaling AI startup from day one.

  • Mission-driven culture: Ambitious team valuing first-principles thinking and bold ideas.

  • Attractive compensation: competitive salary plus significant equity.

  • Best tools for the job: Generous coding tools budget so you can use the best tools for the job.

  • Startup perks: Flexible vacation, team lunches, retreats, central Berlin office.

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro to Cortea with Liza

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Vlad

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

  • On-site Day (Berlin) — Meet the team and work on a real problem together

We’re an equal-opportunity team and encourage women and underrepresented groups to apply.

title: GTM
description:
We're Heidi

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself, we might be a good place for you to start.

Our perspective on GTM

We believe that sales has fundamentally changed in the last 6 months. The repetitive work is automated now: AI does the market research, drafts the emails, summarises and scores the calls.

The last year has taught us that the people who succeed have a blend of the following traits.

  • Intellectual dexterity: consultant-like ability to structure and break down a problem into its constituent parts, think from first principles, and self-improve rapidly. Inherent curiosity goes a long way here.

  • Natural charisma: can build rapport with anyone. You work out quickly who you're talking to, what they're dealing with and what they actually need, then have the conversation that gets you both somewhere.

  • Drive & focus: as AI commoditises intelligence, work ethic and agency matter more. An outlier candidate here is far more productive than the mean than they were two years ago, and the gap keeps widening.

  • The mark of humanity: in a world filling up with AI slop, work where you can feel the person behind it stands out. Where the copy, the imagery, and the strategy is indelibly human.

We don't think the talent market has caught up with how GTM is changing, so we’re open minded - title or experience isn’t important. Most of our team started outside the profession: VC, consulting and creative are common.

This role is high leverage, highly rewarding, and intellectually stimulating. We want you to be part of that.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is genuinely open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn that quiet enthusiasm into real revenue conversations.

You're the first line to Heidi. Inbound demand and product signals point you at practices and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out, or close it yourself. The signals tell you who to reach out to, you decide how.

This is the first rung of our UK sales org, and for most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. How they feel about us afterwards is largely down to you. You'll triage the inbound to your Account Executive's where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across UK healthcare that outlasts the role.

What this means practically:

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed

  • Keep the CRM accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get

  • Track what's shifting in UK healthcare and across the competitive set, then tell the team what you're hearing on the phones

What you'll need

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, creative, banking, consulting or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product actually works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have twenty patients before lunch. You respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Organised and autonomously functioning. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude beats experience here. If you're hungry, competitive and you like solving the problem in front of you, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

description:
Data Scientist - Partner Flow

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team

You'll own experimentation and analytics for iwoca's partner channel – fintechs and platforms that embed iwoca lending in their own products. The analytical approach is still being built, and the scope to shape it is wide.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Partner Flow owns the customer journey from the moment someone starts an application on a partner platform through to a completed credit assessment. By making the application process as smooth as possible and collecting the data needed for a credit decision efficiently, the team maximises the number of partner-referred customers that receive an offer. The team works across the full application stack – from the APIs partners use to integrate iwoca, through to the experience customers see when they apply.

The team is small and cross-functional, combining data science, engineering, design, and product. Active projects include:

  • Pre-qualification – testing how showing customers an offer before they apply affects conversion and long-term value

  • Credit card strategy – iwoca recently launched a credit card alongside its flexi-loan; the team is working out which product, or combination, to offer which customers

  • Funnel optimisation – identifying and reducing the biggest points of friction across the partner journey

The role

You'll design experiments, model customer behaviour and analyse large data sets across the partner funnel, and turn findings into product and strategy decisions. The analytical approach is still being shaped - you'll influence how it develops, not just what it produces.

The work has direct commercial consequences – on partner platforms, iwoca competes for attention alongside other lenders, and what this team builds and tests affects which customers convert and on what terms. You'll work closely with commercial, strategy, and product colleagues across the business.

  • Experimentation and causal inference. You'll design and analyse experiments where careful randomisation and interpretation are critical. You'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. The problems are consequential: measuring how pre-qualification affects Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), and understanding how different products interact when offered to the same customer base.

  • Funnel and competitive strategy. You'll analyse the full partner-referred customer journey – from application through to credit assessment – identifying where conversion breaks down and why. On partner platforms, iwoca is positioned alongside competitors, so you'll also figure out what makes customers choose iwoca over the alternatives, and how to shift those dynamics in our favour.

  • Commercial translation. You'll be directly involved when decisions get made – not handing off analysis to be interpreted by someone else. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and coordinate with adjacent teams to make sure the tests and policies you run fit together with their ongoing work.

  • AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work. The team treats this as a lever for increasing its rate of learning. You'll be expected to have a view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. Strong grounding in probability and statistics, with an understanding of Bayesian reasoning and experience applying hierarchical modelling or decision-making under uncertainty.

  • Causal inference. Experience separating signal from noise in observational and experimental data.

  • Business translation. Ability to understand commercial context and translate data into actionable insights that guide decisions - not just produce analysis, but land it with people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. Proficiency with data manipulation and modelling tools.

  • Analytical ownership. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end - from framing through modelling to influencing decisions.

  • AI fluency. Experience with and a passion for using AI to accelerate and automate analysis and model building.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, adapting technical detail to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. Experience building or adapting statistical or ML models, with an interest in understanding what's happening underneath.

  • Stochastic methods. Familiarity with stochastic modelling concepts as they apply to inference, time series, or uncertainty.

  • Funnel and marketplace experience. Experience with conversion funnel analysis or marketplace dynamics where you're competing for attention alongside competitors.

  • Python. You work primarily in Python. If your background is R or another language, that's fine - but Python is what the team uses day to day.

  • Market curiosity. You want to understand how the partner lending market actually works - what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 – £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
About Numan 
 
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
 
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
 
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
 
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
 
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The Role

We build and operate a regulated digital health platform. Patients trust us with clinical data, identity documents and payment details, and our clinicians trust our systems to be correct. That makes application security a patient safety concern, not just a compliance one.

We are shipping quickly, adopting AI and agentic systems across clinical operations and patient-facing products, and running a lean security function that scales through engineering leverage rather than headcount. We need a senior engineer who can go deep on design and code, then bring the rest of the business along with them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with genuine influence over how the platform is built.

The Team

You will work within the Cyber Security function, collaborating directly with Engineering, Product, Clinical, Legal, and the executive team. Security at Numan is not a gatekeeping function — it scales through influence, credibility, and being useful early.


You'll be:

  • Running threat modelling sessions with product and engineering teams on new features and architectural changes — STRIDE-based, with clinical safety, abuse, and business-logic threats kept in mind alongside the technical ones.

  • Owning and evolving our Secure by Design process: self-evaluation screening, secure design review, and the threat modelling pathway, including our use of automated tooling against technical artefacts.

  • Turning threat models into tracked, prioritised controls that engineering teams actually implement.

  • Pushing design decisions upstream so the cheap fix is designed in rather than the expensive one retrofitted.

  • Assessing and securing AI systems in production: LLM-backed features, retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, tool-calling integrations, and the MCP and API surfaces that connect them.

  • Building practical threat models and controls for agent-specific failure modes — prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, data exfiltration through context, unsafe autonomy, and supply chain risk in model and plugin ecosystems.

  • Performing automated application and API penetration testing against our own products — web, mobile backends, cloud-native services on GCP, internal tooling, and AI features.

  • Leading penetration engagements with third parties and working on the fix with engineering.

  • Chaining findings into realistic attack paths and demonstrating impact, rather than delivering a list of scanner output.

  • Embedding security into our pipelines: SAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container and dependency hygiene — tuned so signal beats noise and engineers trust the gates.

  • Working with platform and engineering to raise baseline standards: authentication and authorisation patterns, secrets management, tenancy isolation, and logging and detection coverage.

  • Actively participating in the security community — OWASP chapters or projects, local meetups, CTFs, research groups — and publishing research, write-ups, or blog posts under your own name.


    • We're looking for someone who:

  • Brings substantial hands-on application security experience in a product engineering environment, at senior level.

  • Has demonstrable threat modelling practice — not just familiarity with the theory.

  • Has practical offensive skills against modern web and API stacks, with an appropriate certification or equivalent demonstrable experience (OSCP, OSWE, CREST, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner or similar).

  • Is comfortable reading and reasoning about code in at least one language used in production systems, and can review a pull request meaningfully.

  • Has working knowledge of cloud-native architecture and its security model — ideally GCP, but AWS or Azure experience transfers.

  • Has experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD, and the scars to know what makes engineers ignore it.

  • Has a track record of shipping security improvements through other teams.

  • Has experience securing AI or agentic systems in production.

  • Has hands-on experience securing Kubernetes environments and managing cloud security posture using CNAPP and CSPM solutions, with a primary focus on GCP but AWS and Azure experience is translatable.

    • It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Regulated environment experience — healthcare, fintech, or similar — and comfort with frameworks such as ISO 27001 without treating compliance as the goal.

title: Technical Artist
description:
SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the geometry of our world, and redefining how industries from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema create and interact with 3D environments.

We are looking for our first Technical Artist to create attention around SpAItial. Our models produce results worth staring at, and we need someone who can make that undeniable in public: short-form video, stills, and interactive demos that people stop for, published on X, LinkedIn, and YouTube at a steady cadence. You will take raw model outputs and make them look spectacular through camera, lighting, motion, VFX, and grade, and build 3D prototypes in Three.js, including AR and XR, that people can actually step into. A technical artist and prototyper, with a public social presence built on your own films, stills, and demos.

You sit next to our product engineers. You own the social presence that puts SpAItial in front of an audience, the artefacts that prove the models, and the prototypes that make the work felt.

We care far more about what you have made than where you have worked. Send us the account and the reel: films, stills, and demos that people remember, and an audience that comes back for the next one.

Responsibilities

  • Attention. Own how SpAItial shows up on X, LinkedIn, and YouTube: the cadence, the craft of each post, and the audience it builds. Turn our models and prototypes into work people stop for and share.

  • Video. Direct, shoot, and cut our films, from short-form pieces made for social to launch films and showreels.

  • Prototypes. Build interactive 3D prototypes in Three.js, including Gaussian splat scenes and AR and XR on headsets and phones, and take an idea to something clickable in days. Unreal is welcome for heavier real-time work.

  • Creative community. Engage designers, architects, technical artists, and spatial computing practitioners, and help run creative partner programs, workshops, and jams.

  • Technical art. Craft beautiful artefacts from our models, designing camera paths, lighting, and composition so a reconstruction reads as a finished piece rather than a research dump.

  • Finishing. Composite, grade, and add VFX, and deliver the stills and sequences that make a result obvious in five seconds.

Key qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in technical art, VFX, real-time 3D, creative technology, or a similar role.

  • A track record of building an audience. You have grown a following by publishing your own films, stills, or demos, and you can shoot, cut, and post short-form video at a weekly cadence without a studio behind you.

  • A portfolio of things you made yourself, publicly visible. We will spend more time on your films, stills, and prototypes than on your CV.

  • Technical-artist craft on 3D content. You can take a scene or a splat and turn it into a finished artefact through camera, lighting, composition, and look development.

  • VFX know-how, including compositing, motion graphics, grading, and shot finishing in tools such as After Effects, Nuke, Fusion, Blender, or Houdini.

  • Able to prototype in Three.js well enough to ship an interactive 3D demo without a hand-off. Experience in Unreal is a strong plus.

  • High ownership and comfortable with ambiguity. You will be the first person in this role and you will define it.

Nice to have

  • An audience that already overlaps ours, in 3D, spatial computing, VFX, or creative technology.

  • Hands-on AR, XR, or headset work: WebXR, native mobile AR, or spatial computing on Vision Pro or Quest.

  • Familiarity with Gaussian splats, photogrammetry, or other captured 3D representations.

  • A background in design, architecture, industrial design, animation, or VFX, or another discipline that trains you to think spatially and in shots.

  • Strong visual design across typography, layout, colour, and motion, applied to web, decks, and launch materials.

  • Experience contributing to a brand identity, including type and motion systems.

  • Experience running community programs, hackathons, or creator partnerships.
